statements.subject: server
statements.description: The PAUSE request causes the stream delivery to immediately be interrupted (halted)... the server acknowledges and enters the Ready state
actions: set pause point to current position in presentation
send 200 OK with Range header indicating remaining unplayed range

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If a client issues a PAUSE request and the server acknowledges and enters the Ready state, the proper server response, if the player issues another PAUSE, is still 200 OK. The 200 OK response MUST include the Range header with the current pause point.
actions: include Range header with current pause point

statements.subject: server
statements.description: servers MAY close the session and free resources after being paused for the duration specified with the timeout parameter of the Session header in the SETUP message

statements.subject: server
statements.description: A subsequent PLAY request without a Range header resumes from the pause point and plays until media end.
actions: resume stream delivery from pause point

statements.subject: message
statements.description: The pause point after any PAUSE request MUST be returned to the client by adding a Range header with what remains unplayed of the PLAY request's range.
statements.guard_semantics: must be present in every PAUSE 200 OK response to indicate the current pause point
